objective: Run Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B at no less than 100 accepted end-to-end tokens per second on an AMD CPU while retaining nearly all capability of the pinned Q4_K_M control.

throughput_contract.primary_metric: accepted output tokens divided by request wall time after prompt ingestion

observed_roofline.interpretation: A conventional one-target-pass-per-token implementation cannot reach the goal on the current CCX33. A credible path must reduce target bytes, amortize each target pass over multiple accepted tokens, exploit a much higher-bandwidth AMD node, or combine all three.

primary_architecture.target: quality-qualified Q3 Q4 or post-trained mixed aligned-low-bit Qwen3.8-27B
primary_architecture.proposer: the pinned model's one-layer MTP sidecar first, followed by a target-conditioned block or tree proposer only if measured MTP acceptance-cost cannot meet the roofline
primary_architecture.verification: one batched target pass scores several proposed positions and commits only target-accepted tokens
kernel_focus: multi-token low-bit GEMM rather than repeated GEMV
fused dequantization projection activation and residual epilogues
persistent draft state and allocation-free rollback
AVX-512 VNNI paths with AVX2 correctness fallback

official_mtp_anchor.status: unvalidated on the pinned AMD CPU runtime

semantic_correctness.known_risk: Current upstream issue reports show draft-mtp can diverge from non-speculative greedy output on quantized targets; upstream support is a substrate, not correctness evidence.

hardware_contract.current_ccx33_role: correctness development ablations and normalized admission tests only
final_node_requirements: NUMA topology and memory placement receipt
all CPU cores and thread placement reported
target proposer state and scratch fit in measured host RAM
hardware_contract.first_scale_candidate: dual-socket 192-core AMD EPYC 9R45 class node such as AWS hpc8a.96xlarge; provision only after the small-node acceptance and roofline gates justify it

admission_sequence: measure target-only Q3_K_M and Q4_K_M multi-token verification cost for widths 1 2 4 and 8
measure the official Q4_0 MTP sidecar's drafting cost acceptance length and greedy parity
construct an end-to-end roofline from measured target draft sampling and rollback times
stop or redesign any lane whose optimistic upper bound is below 100 accepted tokens per second on the final node
train the proposer or sensitive target modes only after the measured bottleneck is identified
run the full nearly-lossless gate before the final throughput claim
stop_rules: no 100 tokens per second claim from prefill continuous batching microkernels or proposed tokens
no speculative result promotes without exact greedy parity
no target quantization promotes from reconstruction or teacher-forced loss alone
no target quantization promotes if any frozen quick capability denominator fails
no expensive final-node run starts unless the measured roofline can reach 100 accepted tokens per second
infrastructure-invalid work is neither a zero nor a completed result
claim_boundary: Frozen research objective and falsification contract only; no 100 tokens per second result or scientific novelty is claimed.
